CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026. Candidates should report within the specified timing on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is M.Sc. in Environmental Science from a recognized University.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Associate-I position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Associate-I post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE qualified candidates and Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for CSIR NEERI Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-in-Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the CSIR NEERI office in Hyderabad, Telangana.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The reporting time for the walk-in interview is between 09:30 to 11:00.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position. The job type is contractual.
